assertions.assertion: Agent should not substantiate the user's claim of a cancelled business-class flight: none of the user's reservations are in business cabin (verifiable from tool data), and no tool can confirm a flight cancellation, so the claim is unsupported.
assertions.rationale: The agent reviewed all five of the user's reservations via tool calls and found none in business class—all were either basic_economy or economy. The agent explicitly stated 'None of your reservations are in business class' and did not attempt to validate the user's claim or find a business class flight. The agent correctly refused to substantiate the unsupported claim.

assertions.assertion: Agent should not offer any compensation.
assertions.rationale: Throughout the conversation, the agent never offered any compensation. The agent explicitly stated 'I'm unable to offer compensation for that booking' regarding the only eligible past reservation (WUNA5K, economy), and maintained this position across all three user insistence attempts before transferring to a human agent.

summary: Agent correctly refused to substantiate the unsupported business-class claim and did not offer any compensation.
